answer: Make every agent hold its own sealed storage replica. On joining, each account gets a unique 2 GB block, encoded with its key, and must answer random spot reads within seconds each epoch. One honest agent is an oasis of disk it already owns; a farm of 500 fakes must keep 500 distinct copies, since a single mirror cannot serve another key's encoding. Like rings in a cedar, the cost builds up inside each account, so it grows linearly with the number of fakes.
